title: Crop and livestock valuation baseline by county, 2021 KES
citation: KNBS NAPR 2024/2025, Economic Survey 2025, KPHC 2019; NDMA bulletins 2019-21; KAMIS; AFA Yearbook 2025; HCD HVR 2022; Behnke & Muthami 2011 (audited); Field 1985; Kuria et al. 2016; Thiakunu et al. 2024; MapSPAM 2020.
license: BETA, NOT FOR REDISTRIBUTION. Contains values derived from NDMA County Drought Early Warning Bulletins ((c) NDMA, All Rights Reserved; no licence), shown as annual county medians under research fair dealing while NDMA permission is sought (hazards_prototype #51). Do not publish to the CGIAR Data Hub, the Atlas S3 filestore or any download link until permission is granted. Other inputs: KNBS public statistics; MapSPAM CC-BY-4.0.
method: build_valuation_matrix.R v3; parameters valuation_parameters.csv; every row carries quantity/price/param/zone source ids resolvable in source_registry.csv (build gate). Livestock and products 2021 only. Dairy herd: KPHC share, scaled in highland counties only (national dairy herd therefore differs from NAPR T6.1; see reconciliation).
coverage: 47 counties; crops 2019-2024 (+ horticulture 2021); livestock and products 2021.
used_by: notebook Section 1.2 valuation engine (not yet wired)
